visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A main female character with long black hair, bangs, and a white clip sits on a red stage in a large, brightly lit exhibition hall. She wears a black T-shirt with white "TEAM UP FIGHT ON" text and a long, layered black lace skirt. She looks around and waves cheerfully at the camera with an expressive smile. (2) Rapid cuts show a large digital billboard with an "AORUS" eagle logo and robotic characters, a close-up of a white plush dragon head with orange eyes, and an orange AORUS logo on a circular floor mat in a high-tech setting. (3) The woman appears again, wearing large black headphones with a boom mic. She holds a gray game controller in front of a screen displaying "Resident Evil Requiem" promotional art. She smiles and looks directly into the lens while gesturing with the controller. (4) She is seen on a professional event stage with another woman; both hold black microphones and address a dense crowd of attendees. The background features high-resolution digital displays with vibrant blue and purple colors and "GIGABYTE AORUS" branding. (5) Close-up shots feature custom-built gaming PCs with white chassis, decorated with colorful floral and anime girl decals. Inside the transparent side panels, small anime figurines are placed on the white GPU and blue-lit cooling fans. (6) The woman stands in front of a large grid of circular digital profile pictures labeled "Honor Wall." She jumps and gestures enthusiastically toward the display while laughing with high energy, surrounded by event branding. (7) A staff member in a black suit pours a neon green energy drink into a plastic cup containing blue liquid. The woman is shown holding the green glowing drink, taking a long sip, and smiling broadly at the camera. (8) At a "Reaction Test" game station, she stands before a vertical black pillar with light-up buttons. She tries to press them quickly as they light up in a sequence, while a cameraman in the background films her. (9) She ends the reaction game segment by covering her face and laughing, showing embarrassment or amusement. Various onlookers and tech equipment are visible in the busy convention background. (10) The video concludes with her back on stage, holding a microphone and a small giveaway card, interacting with the host and audience under bright studio lights.
